titel: The good — a new story for people, planet and future generations
beschrijving: A new story for people, planet and future generations. The book by Etienne Floré, published by Untold.
og_beschrijving: A new story for people, planet and future generations.
ondertitel:
A new story for people, planet
and future generations.
s_p1: When we think about the society we want, most of us think alike. Yet we do not seem to be heading there.
s_p2: All over the world, people and organisations bring the good to life. It is just not yet part of our systems, and it does not yet work together on a large scale.
s_p3: This book names what being human is truly about and inspires us to bring out the best in ourselves and to unite as humankind. From equality and joy for life. From wisdom, flexible thinking and acting, cooperation and reasonableness. From the good.
s_p4: Unlike the top-down workings of the ideologies of capitalism and communism, the ideology of the good works bottom-up.
b_citaat: The good is not naive. It has simply rarely been tried on a large scale.
b_p1: A lifetime of running a business, living together and doubting brought Etienne to one conviction. The good is in each of us.
b_p2: He starts with the Big Bang and ends with a twelve-year-old girl who asks whether there is always hope. In between lie the great questions of being human.
b_p3: This book does not have all the answers. It is a first step. A holistic starting point, on the way to a vision.
b_taal: The book is available in Dutch as Het goede and in French as Le bien.
b_makers: Etienne, Geert Degrande and Wim Floré
knop_noot: 24.95 euros. Free shipping to Belgium, the Netherlands and France.
t_p1: On 26 November we presented the book at Floreac in Lochristi, Belgium. With 325 people in the room, it became a warm and inspiring evening.
t_p2: Wim Demessemaekers of Untold, Etienne, Geert Degrande and Wim Floré took the floor. Charlotte De Mey, Dimitri Barbe, Mieke De Vylder and Peter Depauw then joined a panel conversation led by Ilse Gysel.
t_p3: Thank you to everyone who was there and helped make this evening happen.
v_titel: A vision for the coming century
v_intro: Within the next hundred years, starting from the good, it should be possible to reach:
v_punt1: harmonious and peaceful coexistence of all peoples and all living beings
v_punt2: happiness* for the nine billion people on our earth, with respect for their diversity
v_punt3: a planet that stays within its limits.
v_voetnoot: * See the seven elements of happiness in the book.
v_slot: To get there, we would do well to question our definition of success. We rethink concepts such as money, possessions, ownership, prosperity, growth, … In word and deed, we attach more importance to a resilient population, care, interdependence, introspection, curiosity, reflection, humour, love and justice than to material progress.
d_p1: The story does not end on the last page. On the contrary. It is the start of a movement that works constructively and pragmatically on the steps we can take towards the vision. Together and in dialogue. From our differences and our equality. From a true democracy. It seeks answers to the following questions:
d_vraag1: What if a liveable planet and dignified prosperity for all people were the global goal?
d_vraag2: What if the rules of our global governance were shaped not from the top down, but from the bottom up?
d_p2: It starts small, but thinks big. By joining forces, it aims to grow into a movement that helps give direction to the world.
d_slot: Let’s reinvent democracy and the rules of our society, together.

faq.antwoord:
Het goede asks how we as humans can live well — with each other, with the planet and with the generations that come after us.

Etienne Floré starts from human evolution and then looks at themes such as happiness, freedom, equality, ownership, economy, democracy and ecology. At its heart is the search for a society in which dignified prosperity for everyone goes hand in hand with human freedom and respect for the planet’s limits.

The book ends with a proposal for rolling out the ideology of the good: no fixed model, but a direction in which human values, reasonableness, cooperation and true democracy are central.

faq.vraag: Is the good a political party?
faq.antwoord:
No. Today the good is not a political party, but a movement in the making.

The movement wants to bring together people who want to think and work together around the ideology of the good, through dialogue and democratic decision-making.

The book does not rule out that the movement may become politically active in the longer term. That would only happen once the participants choose so democratically and the movement is developed enough. Political power is not seen as a goal, but as a possible means to bring about change in society.

faq.vraag: Do I have to agree with everything in the book?
faq.antwoord:
No. Quite the opposite.

The book does not want to impose a truth. Many ideas are deliberately put forward as proposals and lines of thought. The intention is that you think for yourself: what do you recognise, what do you doubt and what would you do differently?

Within the movement, too, not everyone needs to hold the same opinion on everything. The starting point is precisely that different insights can lead to better proposals through dialogue and democratic decision-making.

So you don’t have to agree with every idea to think along or help build.

No. Het goede is not a scientific book and does not present itself as one.

It is built on Etienne’s life experience, entrepreneurship, conversations, books, articles, media and his personal reflections on people and society. It contains historical, economic, scientific and political insights, and uses them to develop a story about society and a vision for the future.

So do not see it as an academic study that sets out to prove a theory, but as a personal proposal for society that invites discussion and further exploration.

faq.vraag: Aren’t the ambitions to give the ideology of the good a role on the world stage naive?
faq.antwoord:
Wanting to realise the good is not naive if many people carry it. It is necessary, though, to join the forces of all the people and organisations who already think and act from the good today, in order to reach the vision.

Many people want system change, but a small organisation cannot stand up to the power of capitalism. Cooperation on a large scale is the most important force to peacefully replace the ideology of capitalism with the ideology of the good, on a global scale.

Thanks to technological developments, cooperating on a large scale is more accessible than ever.

faq.vraag: Where can I buy the book?
faq.antwoord: In the Untold webshop, in [Dutch](https://shop.untold-publishing.com/products/het-goede) and in [French](https://shop.untold-publishing.com/products/le-bien), for 24.95 euros. Shipping is free to Belgium, the Netherlands and France.

The movement is only just beginning and still has to get going. The book gives the direction, but not everything is fixed yet.

The aim is to bring together people who want to explore how the ideology of the good can be developed further and put into practice. It starts from true democracy: listening to different insights, engaging in dialogue, building knowledge together and so arriving at decisions that work.

You choose how far you want to go: simply stay informed, take part in conversations and gatherings, or actively help build the movement.

In the longer term, the movement may also develop proposals for society and politics. But the aim is not to gain power as quickly as possible. First, a strong, democratic movement needs to grow, developing its ideas and ways of working together with everyone who takes part.
